blocks.text:
The Samsung Chromebook Plus V2 is a 2-in-1 laptop that can be used as a tablet or laptop. The laptop runs on Chrome OS. It has a 360-degree flip design and a lightweight build. The laptop features a touchpad with multi-touch support, a Built-in pen, a wireless mouse, and a 13 MP webcam.
Specifications:
Series: Samsung Chromebook
Standing screen display size: 13 Inches
Max Screen Resolution: 1920*1080 Pixels
Processor: 1.5 GHz Celeron 3965Y
Processor Brand: Intel
Processor Count: 1
RAM: 4 GB LPDDR3
Hard Drive: 64GB eMMC SSD
Graphics Coprocessor: Intel HD Graphics 615
Chipset Brand: Intel
Card Description: Integrated
Wireless Type: 802.11ac
Hardware Platform: Chrome OS
Operating System: Chrome OS
Includes: Pen and Wireless Mouse
Color: Light Titan
Touchscreen: Yes
Item Weight: 2.98 pounds
Ports: Micro SD card slot (card NOT included), Headphone/Mic combo port, 2 USB-C and 1 USB 3.0 ports
Product Dimensions: 11.35 x 0.67 x 8.2 inches

items: The bright and vivid 12.2" touchscreen 1920x1080 60Hz FHD display lets you stream your favorite shows, browse online, and more in stunning detail; Wi-Fi 5, Bluetooth 4.0, Webcam, Wireless Mouse, Integrated Pen.
The 3rd Gen Intel Celeron 3965Y 1.50GHz Processor (2MB Cache, 2-Cores, 2-Threads) provides fast and efficient performance for everyday tasks; Intel UHD 615 Graphics.
It comes with 4GB LPDDR3 RAM; 45W Power Supply, and a 1-Cell 39 WHr Battery, You can use this laptop all day without having to worry about recharging.
64GB eMMC SSD; 1 USB 3.0 (Type A), 2 USB 3.2 (Type-C), Micro SD Reader, No Optical Drive, Headphone/Microphone Combo Jack.
This laptop comes with a light titan color and is pre-installed with the Google Chrome operating system, which is known for its speed, simplicity, and security.

Compatible Devices
